notes:
Snapshot: mid-market product team building a search + discovery layer for 3rd-party marketplace integrations. Primary interest is improving relevance via a reranking endpoint and offline scoring to re-rank catalog nightly.

Discovery & context:
- 2025-11-02: inbound demo request via website; initial qualification call with Jordan.
- Product team size ~14 engineers + 3 ML engineers; high velocity on experiments.
- Current stack: Elastic + in-house learning-to-rank; looking to replace heuristics with neural reranker for top-50 candidate reordering.

Technical requirements and goals (customer-specified):
- Workload: reranking of candidate lists (N=30-100), also embeddings for similarity signals.
- Target metric uplift: +8-12% NDCG@10 vs current BM25+LTR baseline (measured on their eval set).
- Latency SLO: 150ms p95 for online rerank (batched calls per query).
- Throughput: 200 qps during peak; offline batch scoring for nightly re-rank (10M items).
- Cost sensitivity: mid; willing to pay for reserved capacity if predictability lowers unit cost.
- Model preferences: open/instruction-tuned LLMs compatible with quantized runtimes; prefer transparent perf profiles.
- Routing/fallback: need automatic fallback to smaller model when capacity limited.

Security & compliance notes:
- Must comply with customer EU data residency for PII-containing metadata (catalog owner IDs).
- Require SSO (SAML) + audit logs + KMS integration for keys.
- Asking for SOC2 Type II evidence and ISO27001 summary during security review.

Engagement timeline & activities:
- 2026-01-15: hosted API demo (rerank endpoint + streaming) with AE + SE. Fireflies: ff_2026-01-15_demo.
- 2026-02-12: deep-dive call to define eval set and offline scoring spec (Maya led).
- 2026-02-18: pricing conversation, asked for Dedicated reserved throughput options and TCO for 3 tiers.
- Current plan: run 4-week POC using hosted API for integration speed, then pilot Dedicated for predictable latency and cost.

POC scope (agreed tentative):
- Meridian to provide canonical eval set (queries, relevance labels) and sample catalog (subset ~100k items).
- Redwood to deliver: rerank endpoint configured for their model choices, notebook with scoring examples, batch scoring job template, and baseline NDCG reports.
- Success criteria: >=8% NDCG@10 uplift OR measurable CTR proxy improvement on shadow traffic + acceptable latency under 200ms p95.

Open questions from Meridian:
- Can Redwood support offline bulk scoring with exportable scores (CSV or BigQuery)?
- Exact pricing for Dedicated with 200 qps reserved throughput — want a 12-month committed quote.
- How model rollout can be managed across dedicated and hosted (pin versions, canary)?

Sales & negotiation notes:
- Meridian is price-conscious but pragmatic: if Dedicated reduces per-token cost by >30% and guarantees latency, they will shift.
- Procurement timeline: internal budget review to conclude by 2026-03.
- Legal/security: security questionnaire in progress (SEC-1189).

Next steps (short):
- SE to send POC onboarding checklist + sample notebook by 2026-02-25.
- Meridian to share sanitized eval set and sample catalog by 2026-03-01.
- Schedule pricing discussion with product ops for Dedicated pricing on 2026-02-28.

CRM tone: bullets, shorthand, call quotes: 'We need reliable reranks at 150ms — can't exceed 250ms p95 in production.'
